<<<INDENT>>>Earlier this week, the Carolina Panthers announced that they'll be without starting right tackle Taylor Moton for an extended period. On Thursday, they might have suffered another key injury. Pass rusher Nic Scourton, who tied for the team lead in sacks as a rookie last season, went down with a right knee injury, according to the Charlotte Observer, and was carted off the field. We don't yet know the severity of the injury, but his Panthers teammates' reaction to it spoke volumes. <<<INDENT>>>(cont) Most of the players on the field went over to check on Scourton, appearing concerned with his well-being, before he was brought back to the locker room.

<<<INDENT>>>The next phase of the offseason has officially kicked off as players begin to report for NFL training camps this week, starting with the 2026 NFL Draft class. All 32 teams will report to training camp by July 28, though there are several teams getting a jump on things early. Both the Arizona Cardinals and Carolina Panthers will have both rookies and veterans reporting by July 22 as they're set to play in the Hall of Fame Game on August 6.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) The Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots are the next two teams to have veterans report (July 24), set to open up the 2026 regular season with a Super Bowl LX rematch on Wednesday, September 9. We know players like Nick Bosa, George Kittle, <<<INDENT>>>(cont) and Mykel Williams are recovering from season-ending injuries. <<<INDENT>>>By the start of training camp, teams want their rosters and depth charts mostly figured out. That's the dream. It doesn't always happen.

<<<INDENT>>>Fernando Mendoza and the Las Vegas Raiders have a deal. Mendoza signed his rookie contract with the Raiders, the team announced Thursday, July 23. Mendoza signed a four-year, 57. 2 million fully guaranteed contract.

<<<INDENT>>>It's never too early to get ready for the start of another NFL season. As we await the start of training camps in late July, we're releasing 2026 team previews in reverse order of our initial power rankings. Frank Schwab's previews will come out every weekday from now until early August, when he reveals his No.

<<<INDENT>>>Woodland Hills, - June 08:Rams Myles Garrett (95) at Rams practice on Monday, June 8, 2026. (Photo by David Crane/MediaNews Group/Los Angeles Daily News via Getty Images) MediaNews Group via Getty Images Myles Garrett had an NFL record 23 sacks with the Cleveland Browns last season, which is phenomenal, but his legacy could be even better if he improved on his mark in 2026 with the Los Angeles Rams. At least one NFL writer thinks that he will. <<<INDENT>>>(cont) It’s not that Garrett’s sack record is not legitimate, but imagine how much better his legacy would be if Garrett got to 23 sacks in 16 games instead of 17 games.

<<<INDENT>>>With rookies reporting to training camp on Thursday, the Raiders have taken care of an important piece of business. No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza has signed his rookie contract, the team announced.

Mandatory Credit: Katie Stratman-Imagn Images Katie Stratman-Imagn Images The Chicago Bears carried four safeties last year, and if that trend continues, then there’s not much drama at this position this season. Roster LocksThe Bears paid Coby Bryant 40 million over three years to man one safety spot, <<<INDENT>>>(cont) so he’ll essentially replace Kevin Byard III, who not only played at an All-Pro level but was also the captain of the defense both years in the Windy City.

<<<INDENT>>>The Athletic recently gathered their NFL reporters together to compile a list by choosing one player from each team who they believe has the most at stake entering the 2026 season. For the Dallas Cowboys, Jon Machota chose linebacker DeMarvion Overshown. Dallas Cowboys: DeMarvion Overshown, LBThree players immediately come to mind: Overshown, LT Tyler Guyton and WR George Pickens. Overshown gets the nod because he’s in the final year of his rookie contract.

Throughout the year we ask questions of the most plugged-in Falcons fans and fans across the country.

<<<INDENT>>>Editor’s note: We’ll be running down some key roster battles in the the leadup to Washington Commanders training camp later this month. John Portis has taken the lead on this series that will look at rookies, veterans, and free agents who are fighting for playing time in July. The Washington Commanders have Terry McLaurin locked in as their No. 1 wide receiver for the 2026 season.

<<<INDENT>>>The Carolina Panthers lost one of their key defensive players, Nic Scourton, to a serious-looking right leg injury at their July 23 training camp practice. Scourton was unable to put pressure on his right knee after suffering the injury, according to NFL Media's Cameron Wolfe. "It appears significant," Wolfe wrote of Scourton's injury in a post to X. "Trainers were looking at his right knee. Teammates near him were very emotional with their frustration. <<<INDENT>>>(cont) "Scourton was carted off the field shortly after suffering the injury, according to Mike Kaye of The Charlotte Observer.

<<<INDENT>>>ESPN, if you haven't heard, is making plenty of changes in the aftermath of the April 1 takeover of NFL Network. One thing has remained the same. The two networks are partnering on a continuation of "Back Together Weekend. "Of course, it wasn't an NFL Network initiative. The league tried to make it into a thing several years ago.

<<<INDENT>>>It’s Carolina’s first day of training camp, and the club is already dealing with an injury to a key player. Via multiple reporters on the scene, outside linebacker Nic Scourton suffered an apparent right knee injury during 11-on-11 drills. He was carted off of the field, albeit in the front seat. Scourton was emotional as he left the field, with several players coming over to console him. Scourton was a second-round pick last year and put together a solid rookie season, tallying 5.0 sacks, <<<INDENT>>>(cont) seven tackles for loss, and nine quarterback hits in 17 games.

<<<INDENT>>>In 2025, the Los Angeles Rams offense evolved from a team that was primarily based on one tight end to a unit that embraced three. L. A. coach Sean McVay didn’t use the three tight end formation until Week 6 of the regular season and from then on, according to Next Gen Stats, proceeded to employ it on 43 percent of plays going forward. The Rams appear to be all-in on staying with the multiple tight end offense.

<<<INDENT>>>EAST RUTHERFORD, NJ- JUNE 03: John Harbaugh head coach of the New York Giants speaks at the podium wearing a New York Knicks hat after OTA Practice on June 3, 2026 at Quest Diagnostic Center in East Rutherford, New Jersey. (Photo by Rich Graessle/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) Icon Sportswire via Getty Images As training camp approaches, the excitement and anticipation among Giants fans is almost palpable with the John Harbaugh Giants era about to begin.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) Now is a good time to ask: What would a successful Harbaugh tenure look like, and how likely is it to happen?I specifically chose the featured image of Harbaugh above because it shows him wearing a New York Knicks cap after their thrilling (and I mean thrilling, I don’t know how much more exciting you can get than those NBA Finals games) run to the NBA Championship.

<<<INDENT>>>SANTA CLARA, CA - AUGUST 04: San Francisco 49ers defensive lineman Mykel Williams (98) looks on during San Francisco 49ers Training Camp on August 4, 2025 at the SAP Performance Facility in Santa Clara, CA. (Photo by Matthew Huang/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Each year, as we head into the regular season, teams are ranked by the talent they have on the current roster under the age of 25. Last year, the Niners ranked 30th in this exercise. <<<INDENT>>>Every football fan has that one analyst they refuse to miss. Some tune in for detailed X’s and O’s. Others want breaking news the moment it happens.
